user.title: Add a store
user.description: Each store is added separately, so run this once per store. Chains whose ad differs by location ask one more question: a ZIP code (Albertsons, Safeway, Fred Meyer, Grocery Outlet, Costco) or which store (99 Ranch Market, Asian Family Market). The rest have a single ad and are added straight away.

data_description.store_type: Pick "Mealie (recipes on sale)" to connect a Mealie instance instead of a store.

postal_code.title: ZIP code
postal_code.description: {store}'s weekly ad differs by area. Enter the ZIP code you shop in and the ad for the nearest {store} is used.

data_description.location_id: 5-digit US ZIP code, for example 97005. To track a second area, add {store} again with another ZIP.

store.title: Choose a store
store.description: {store}'s weekly ad differs per store. Pick the one you shop at.

data_description.location_id: To track a second store, add {store} again and pick another.

store_number.title: Store number
store_number.description: The list of {store} stores couldn't be loaded, so enter the store number by hand. Open your store's weekly ad on the store's website: the number is the last part of the page address, for example 1693 in {example_url}.

mealie.title: Connect Mealie
mealie.description: Ranks your Mealie recipes by which ingredients are in this week's ads. Only ever reads from Mealie.

data_description.url: The address you open Mealie at, for example {example_url}.
data_description.token: Create one in Mealie under your profile, API Tokens.

error.no_ad_found: No current ad was found for this store near that ZIP code. Check the ZIP, or try a neighbouring one.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the service. Check the address and your connection, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This store and location is already set up.
